description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific metric alert rule within a Sentry organization. Note: This endpoint is specifically for metric alert rules (organization-level alerts based on metrics like error count, latency, failure rate, etc.). For issue alert rules (project-level alerts triggered by events), use the project rules endpoint instead. The API may return 404 if: - The alert rule ID does not exist - The organization does not have metric alerts enabled - The organization does not exist or you don't have access
